input.objective:
Deploy one contract on Sepolia: a Uniswap v4 hook for an existing token, 0x1f9840a85d5aF5bf1D1762F925BDADdC4201F984 (UNI), paired with ETH. No new token, no pool created by the launch; I will initialize the UNI/ETH pool with this hook myself afterwards. Behavior, and nothing else:
1. Take 1.0% of the ETH side of every buy and sell as a hook fee, settled in ETH inside the swap that paid it (mint a claim when the PoolManager cannot pay it directly), and send it to the owner.
Owner $owner may only: change the fee recipient. No other admin function, no backend signer, no upgrade path. Take the PoolManager as a constructor argument (Sepolia PoolManager 0xE03A1074c86CFeDd5C142C4F04F1a1536e203543). The deployed address must carry the correct hook permission bits.
